subject: Reconciling approval chain & procurement steps — StratoHealth pilot
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Lewis <dana.lewis@stratohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Reconciling approval chain & procurement steps — StratoHealth pilot

Hi Dana —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and two asks so we can keep the pilot procurement moving: 

1) Recap (from our discovery):
- Pilot target: run inference on anonymized claims data for classification + intent scoring; target throughput ~150 rps.
- Success criteria: 95% of baseline accuracy, sub-150ms median token latency for the 4k prompt mix, and cost under $0.08/token-equivalent for the pilot window.
- Compliance notes: PV data will remain within your VPC; you requested KMS + audit logs for retention.

2) Asks (today):
- Can you confirm who is the fiscal owner who signs off on spend (procurement vs finance)? We want to loop them into a short pricing + contract outline.
- Could you share the procurement recipient for security questionnaires and any required CLA/vendor vetting? We attached a short mutual action plan and a draft SOW to seed the conversation.

I’ve included Marissa (solutions) for technical follow-up and Ben (contracts) for the commercial outline. If it helps, we can prepare a one-page procurement packet tailored to StratoHealth requisites.

Attachments: RDW_Strato_MutualActionPlan_v1.xlsx; Strato_SOW_v1.pdf

Next steps I propose:
- Dana to confirm fiscal approver + procurement contact (reply)
- If proc requires a security questionnaire, we can fill the vendor form within 48 hours once we have the contact
- 30-min follow-up next Tue/Wed to review final SOW & pricing

Thanks — appreciate the quick turn here.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0143
Redwood Inference

From: Dana Lewis <dana.lewis@stratohealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reconciling approval chain & procurement steps — StratoHealth pilot

Vanessa —

Appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers:

- Fiscal owner: Dana Lewis (me) — I own the pilot budget for innovation projects under $250k. For anything above that threshold it goes to CFO review, but we’re under that for the pilot as scoped.
- Procurement/security: Evan Chu (procurement@stratohealth.com) handles vendor onboarding and security questionnaires. I’m copying Evan here for handoff.

Evan — can you confirm typical SLAs/clauses you require and whether we need company-wide legal redlines for an SOW under $100k? If there’s a standard PO process, please flag it.

Also attaching the vendor onboarding checklist so you know what to expect on our side.

Thanks,
Dana
VP, Product Strategy
StratoHealth

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Lewis <dana.lewis@stratohealth.com>, Evan Chu <procurement@stratohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reconciling approval chain & procurement steps — StratoHealth pilot

Thanks Dana — and hi Evan, good to e-meet. 

Evan — quick note on timing and what we can deliver immediately to speed onboarding:
- We can complete StratoHealth’s vendor security questionnaire within 24–48 hours once you send the latest version. Marissa will handle the technical responses and provide the runtime architecture diagram.
- Ben can prepare a pilot SOW and the standard Redwood commercial terms; we can produce a PO-ready packet if your procurement team prefers that instead of a standalone SOW.
- For KMS and audit log evidence, we can share a redacted sample of our audit export and the KMS integration checklist.

Proposed immediate actions:
1) Evan to share vendor questionnaire + PO template (if any) — target: EOD Thu 9/16
2) We’ll return completed questionnaire + a one-page summary of the pilot SOW — target: Fri 9/17
3) 30-min alignment call to confirm final pricing and sign-off path — propose Mon 9/20 10am PT (open to other times)

Please let us know if there are any mandatory commercial redlines or a procurement portal we should use.

Thanks — looking forward to moving forward.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0143
